items.subject: Bracknell Forest Council is hiring a Housing Led Officer (FTC 18 months)
items.summary: New public-sector and housing vacancies include Housing Led Officer at Bracknell Forest Council, Data Protection Officer at Mid Sussex District Council, Senior Licensing and Housing Enforcement Officer at Lewisham Council, and a Surrey maintenance role.
items.action: Review the Bracknell Housing Led Officer role first, then compare the Lewisham and Surrey roles for salary, requirements, closing date and commute before deciding whether to apply.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether any of the newly listed public-sector or housing roles are suitable enough to apply for.
